summary: This class models the Add Device page in the HPX Rebranding flow for Windows automation testing. It inherits from HPXRebrandingFlow and provides comprehensive verification and action methods for device addition workflows. The class follows a clear pattern of separating verification methods (verify_*) from action methods (click_*, input_*, get_*). Key features include: (1) Multiple verification methods for UI elements with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (2) Support for both serial number and product number-based device addition, (3) Integration with Microsoft Store for HP Smart app installation, (4) Navigation controls including back and close buttons, (5) Help and support link verification for user assistance. The class uses a driver-based approach for element interaction, utilizing wait_for_object, click, send_keys, and get_attribute methods. This design pattern enables robust test automation with explicit waits and flexible error handling, making it suitable for enterprise-scale UI testing of the device addition workflow.
